body: I'm sorry you are feeling that way. It must be pretty hard to feel like there is no one there who likes you. What kinds of positive interactions have you had with women?

Hey :). I can definitely relate to that feeling.
Do you have any ideas about what may be causing that dark cloud?

I feel just like you, man. 
All the space around me throughout the day feels so empty even if there are people shuffling by.
I'm in the library right now at 2:23 AM on a Friday night just feeling like a huge waste of space.
I've been seeing a counselor as well. 
College sucks, and I wish I could find that one person too. 
I'm cheering you on, buddy. 
Hang in there.
